ai_summary.key_headline: Nati's Possession Control Tested by Compact Bosnia Block

switzerland.philosophy: Compact mid-block with aggressive counter-pressing and wing-back progression.

bosnia_and_herzegovina.philosophy: Direct attacking transitions focused on Edin Dzeko's aerial target play.

tactical_insights: Granit Xhaka will dictate the pace from deep, attempting to pull Bosnia's double pivot out of position.
Bosnia will defend deep and seek to launch direct long balls to exploit Edin Dzeko's physical presence.
Switzerland's wide center-backs must stay vigilant against Bosnia's quick wing counter-attacks.
